children: Cognition is on track to reach $1B in annualized revenue this month, roughly doubling its run rate from about four months ago, Bloomberg reported, citing a person familiar with the matter.
The AI coding startup's annualized revenue run rate topped $900M in September, up from $492M in May. The growth has been driven by demand for its Devin AI coding software.
